column2: Claim audit 1: two blind auditors, 24 verdicts. Jer 49, Joel, Mic 7, Num 24 and Jer 38:22 hold; most new contacts came down.
v2.1, finalised: built from the Hebrew; one full dig, the Jer 49 synoptic run, claim audits 1–2 and Logos rounds 1–2 applied.
v1.3, fresh dig on the whole book; claim audits 1 and 2 and Logos round 1 applied.
The July and November overviews compared.
Round 1 questions for the Logos Research Assistant: date, direction, cruxes, the audit's history rows, lexicons and free checks.
Round 1 answers tested against the text: date, direction, cruxes, lexicons, library; recommended changes, applied in overview v1.3 and dig v1.2.
The last seven round 1 questions; all answered, and round 1 closed.
v1.1, synoptic run with Jer 49:7–22, corrected by claim audit 2: not one text; Jer 49 a compilation; its Obadiah lines from outside Jeremiah; direction open.
Claim audit 2: two blind auditors, 18 verdicts. vv. 12–14 past holds; v. 17 down to moderate; Jer 49 compilation confirmed; house-vocabulary finding discarded.
Round 2 questions for Logos on the items the finalised overview leaves open: v. 16, vv. 12–14, Jer 49 direction, v. 17, Joel, Num 24, the untested queue.
Round 2 answers tested: Mur 88 and the Targum at vv. 16, 17, 20; v. 17 split, moderate; 'around' closed; Assis's vv. 1–9; holders for Joel, Num 24 and the queue. Applied in overview v2.1.
Sermon backbone for one sermon on the whole book (ESV pulpit): FCF, Teaching Point, Purpose, Big Question, four movements, Keep Honest, pulpit-text note.
